node.statement: Raw polar-input estimate: if epsilon_r<=1/64 and U,V are in calU, then U^dagger and U bold-dot V both have right inverses and satisfy ||(U^dagger)^dagger bold-dot U^dagger-J||<=25*epsilon_r and ||(U bold-dot V)^dagger bold-dot(U bold-dot V)-J||<=40*epsilon_r.
